title: KAITO — I Can't Sit Back〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm not okay with you turning a blind eye to what you're really feeling...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why is it that their first option is to always run from what they're feeling?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do I even have to say...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You went to see Kanade, didn't you...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why did you ask if you already knew the answer?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Unless...
You're here for something else.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You didn't come with me when I said that I was going over to see Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which probably means you were eavesdropping on our conversation.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I sat back quietly and didn't interrupt.
Or did you want me to butt in?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My, what an unfortunate turn of events.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm not excited per se.
Didn't I just say that it's an “unfortunate” turn of events?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
KAITO just can't help himself, can he?
I should see if I can smooth things out between them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is there something you'd like to say, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Not really...
I just feel that the person who sowed these seeds is responsible.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How's your drawing coming along, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I've only made a little progress.
It's so hard to draw things up close and far away.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, Rin, where are you going?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO, did something happen between you and Rin?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
She was so worried about Kanade too...
But a certain someone decided to eavesdrop and rob her of a chance to listen and help.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, what do you plan on doing?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Rin.
Are you going to keep letting her feel this way forever?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's just being stubborn is all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But wouldn't apologizing to her be the adult thing to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You seem to be enjoying all of this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? You still haven't answered my question.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have no intention of entertaining you.
